title: Homology of derived exchange on strict-local global sections
statement: For f:X→S, a geometric point s, a bounded-below injective complex J and q:K≅Q(ιJ), in every integer degree n, the homology of the transported derived mate followed by the exact-sections Leray target comparison equals homology of the underived exchange on global sections followed by representativeSectionsComparison. No neighbourhood restriction is used. All mate target comparisons in this statement use the small coordinate-ring colimit model of [def-weil-pbc-small-model-mate-projection-data].

source.place: Tag 03Q9, final injective-complex paragraph; details of the adjunction compatibility written by P1

proof.text: Use naturality of the exact sections/homology comparison to move the mate to the derived category. Expand smallModel_strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso and cancel that comparison. Apply degree-n homology to strictLocalDerivedExchange_leray and expand representativeSectionsComparison.

Use the general pointed-section-cone restriction on strictLocalSectionCone, the existing exact-sections instance for the small colimit model, and the general exact-global-sections Leray comparison wherever the former specialized restriction API was used. The cone restriction has the same section formulas, its germ predicate is definitionally identical, and uniqueness identifies the chosen stalk maps. All other argument steps and all scheme models stay as before.
